verdict.rationale: The documented API, CLI and MCP operations are all single-item, such as `POST /contacts/create` and `PUT /contacts/update` for one contact by email or userId. No batch or bulk endpoint or command is described. Campaign sends to a segment are an email-delivery feature rather than bulk operations on items, and CLI JSON output for scripting is only a building block, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
